topic: Stage 05 deployment preflight: can api/ run on Vercel Hobby as a personal pilot
decision_ref: docs/planning/approved-decisions.json (api_host: Vercel Hobby accepted default for a personal non-commercial pilot)

vercel_facts.nestjs: Zero-configuration support. The entry file src/main.ts is detected; the whole app becomes one Vercel Function on Fluid compute. Bundle limit 250 MB.
vercel_facts.hobby_limits: Free. Monthly: 4 active CPU-hours, 360 GB-hours provisioned memory, 1,000,000 function invocations, 100 GB fast data transfer. Function maximum duration 300 s. Runtime logs kept 1 hour. 100 deployments per day.
vercel_facts.over_limit: No billing on Hobby: a feature that exceeds its limit is paused, usually until 30 days have passed.
vercel_facts.terms: Hobby is for non-commercial, personal use only. A public commercial release needs a new hosting-terms check (AGENTS.md, Product boundaries).

local_simulation.method: Clean clone of main (826774b) in a scratch folder; install and build inside api/ only, as a Vercel project with Root Directory api would; then run dist/main.js without a settings file and with dummy values.
results: npm ci inside api/ then npm run build: FAILED. The prebuild step builds ../content, whose own packages (typescript types, zod) were never installed: error TS2688 Cannot find type definition file for 'node'.
After also installing content (npm ci --prefix ../content): build passed.
Without SUPABASE_URL and SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY the server stops at startup with an explicit error.
With dummy values it starts; GET /v1/units/C01-U01 and POST /v1/units/C01-U01/start without a token answer 401 and the log shows the reason only.
local_simulation.fix: api/vercel.json sets installCommand to install content and then api. The missing-settings error now names both places (local file, Vercel Environment Variables).

expected_in_a_deployment: ALLOW_DRAFT_UNITS is never set in Vercel, and readConfig refuses it when VERCEL is set. The 1A draft therefore answers 404 there until 1A is published. A deployment proves build, settings, HTTPS and the token guard, not the lesson; lesson development continues against the local server.
The Vercel project must keep 'Include files outside the root directory in the Build Step' enabled (default), or ../content is not available to the build.
The function region should be the one closest to the Supabase project's region (Supabase: Project Settings, General).
open_until_first_deployment: Whether Vercel's NestJS integration accepts the top-level 'await bootstrap()' in src/main.ts (ESM) without change; the first deployment log answers it.
Cold-start time from the iPhone on the first request after idle.
account_steps_for_dor: Create a Vercel Hobby account with GitHub, import doric2000/spanish-for-the-big-trip with Root Directory api, enter SUPABASE_URL and SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY as Sensitive environment variables in the Vercel UI (never in chat or Git), choose the function region, deploy. Free; no payment method needed.
